title: Chemical reactions: question set (20 marks)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 55 (Reactions question set (20 marks) and mark scheme (portal))
intro: Answer every question. Show working and units for calculations. Mark it with the mark scheme.

questions.q: Give two signs that a chemical reaction has happened.
questions.a: Gas given off, colour change, temperature change, a new solid forms (any two)

questions.q: Write the word equation for magnesium reacting with oxygen.
Write the word equation for bicarbonate of soda reacting with vinegar (ethanoic acid).
questions.a: Sodium hydrogencarbonate + ethanoic acid → sodium ethanoate + water + carbon dioxide

questions.q: How could you test for the gas made in that reaction?
questions.a: Bubble it through limewater (1): it turns milky (cloudy) (1)

questions.q: A reaction in an open flask loses 2.2 g. Explain why the mass seems to decrease.
questions.a: A gas is made and escapes (1); mass is conserved, it has left the flask (1)

questions.q: 12 g of magnesium burns to make 20 g of magnesium oxide. What mass of oxygen reacted?
What is an exothermic reaction? Give an example.
questions.a: Gives out energy (heat) to the surroundings (1); for example burning, neutralisation, respiration (1)

questions.q: What is the pH of a neutral solution? Name the reaction between an acid and an alkali.
Write the word equation for hydrochloric acid reacting with sodium hydroxide.
questions.a: Hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide → sodium chloride + water

questions.q: Explain why a reaction is faster with powder than with lumps.
questions.a: Powder has a larger surface area (1), so particles collide more often (1)
